Still raho, aur jaan lo: main hi God hoon.
Bura waqt hamesha nahi rehta, par majboot log hamesha tikte hain.
Himmat—darte hue bhi kaam ka hunar.
Himmat mazedaar hai.
Grit lachila-pan hai.
Saat gir, aath uth.
Khamoshi clarify karti hai.
Himmat rakho, shaant raho.
Sabar kamyabi ki maa hai.
Sabse dark nights brightest stars deti hain.
Suraj ki taraf chehra rakho.
Courage sabse pehli insani quality hai kyunki yeh sab qualities ko guarantee karta hai.
Grit lohe jaisi ichha hai.
Brave shayad long live na karein, cautious waise bhi survive nahi karte.
Khamoshi sachchi dost hai.
Perseverance victory ka engine hai.
Silence emptiness nahi; purpose wali pause hai.
Kabhi kabhi khamoshi sabse loud hoti hai.
Hum pahad ko nahi, balki apne aap ko jeette hain.
Himmat growth choose karti hai.
Khamoshi thoughts ke beech ki jagah hai.
